description: This file contains validation utility functions for form data, including various validators for dates, numbers, file uploads, email, phone, URLs, and other input formats, as well as functions for inter-field validation logic.

methods.name: required
methods.description: Checks if the value is present and not empty. Supports string, number, array, and object types.

methods.name: shouldNotExceedCharLength
methods.description: Returns a validator function that ensures a string does not exceed a specified character length.

methods.name: validDateFormat
methods.description: Validator that checks if a date string matches a specified date format.

methods.name: shouldBeCurrentOrPreviousDate
methods.description: Validates that a date is the current date or a previous date.

methods.name: validTimeFormat
methods.description: Checks if a time string is in valid HH:mm format.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Returns a validator that ensures a numeric value does not exceed a maximum value.

methods.name: digitsOnly
methods.description: Checks if a string contains only digits.

methods.name: numericOnly
methods.description: Checks if a string contains only numeric characters (digits).

methods.name: digitsOnlyWithDecimalPoint
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid number possibly with a decimal point.

methods.name: digitsOnlyWithDecimalPointAndMinusSign
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid number possibly with a decimal point and minus sign (negative numbers).

methods.name: beforeDate
methods.description: Checks if one date is before another date.

methods.name: afterDate
methods.description: Checks if one date is after another date.

methods.name: sameDate
methods.description: Checks if two dates are the same.

methods.name: endDateShouldBeAfterStartDate
methods.description: Validates that an end date is after a start date, with optional allowance for same date.

methods.name: beforeTime
methods.description: Checks if one time is before another.

methods.name: afterTime
methods.description: Checks if one time is after another.

methods.name: sameTime
methods.description: Checks if two times are the same.

methods.name: endTimeShouldBeAfterStartTime
methods.description: Validates that an end time is after a start time, with optional allowance for same time.

methods.name: maxFileSize
methods.description: Checks if a file size does not exceed a maximum size.

methods.name: validFileTypes
methods.description: Checks if a file's type is within allowed types.

methods.name: validEmailFormat
methods.description: Validates that a string is in proper email format.

methods.name: validPhoneNumberFormat
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid phone number format.

methods.name: startDateShouldBeBeforeEndDate
methods.description: Validates that a start date is before an end date, with optional allowance for same date.

methods.name: maxCurrency
methods.description: Validates that a currency value does not exceed a maximum limit.

methods.name: startTimeShouldBeBeforeEndTime
methods.description: Validates that a start time is before an end time, with optional allowance for same time.

methods.name: shouldNotLessThanCharLength
methods.description: Checks if a string is at least a certain length.

methods.name: maxValueShouldBeGreaterThanMinValue
methods.description: Checks if a value is greater than a specified minimum.

methods.name: minValueShouldBeLowerThanMaxValue
methods.description: Checks if a value is less than a specified maximum.

methods.name: numberShouldBeBetweenMinAndMaxValue
methods.description: Checks if a numeric string is within a specified range.

methods.name: validHexFormat
methods.description: Validates if a string is a valid hex color code.

methods.name: imageShouldHaveDimensions
methods.description: Asynchronously validates if an image has the specified aspect ratio within a tolerance.

methods.name: greaterThanOrEqual
methods.description: Checks if a number is greater than or equal to a minimum.

methods.name: lessThanOrEqual
methods.description: Checks if a number is less than or equal to a maximum.

methods.name: validLangString
methods.description: Validates language string formatting (matching braces).

methods.name: validSelection
methods.description: Validates that a selection value is not a string (i.e., an object or valid selection).

methods.name: validHostnameFormat
methods.description: Validates if a string is a valid hostname or IP address.

methods.name: validPortRange
methods.description: Validates if a string represents a port number within a specified range and length.

methods.name: validVideoURL
methods.description: Checks if a URL is a valid YouTube video link.

methods.name: digitsOnlyWithTwoDecimalPoints
methods.description: Checks if a string is a number with up to two decimal points.

ctags.name: digitsOnly
ctags.pattern: /^export const digitsOnly = function (value: string): boolean | string {$/

ctags.name: lessThanOrEqual
ctags.pattern: /^export const lessThanOrEqual = function (maxValue: number, message?: string) {$/

ctags.name: numericOnly
ctags.pattern: /^export const numericOnly = function (value: string): boolean | string {$/

ctags.name: validEmailFormat
ctags.pattern: /^export const validEmailFormat = function (value: string): boolean | string {$/

ctags.name: validHostnameFormat
ctags.pattern: /^export const validHostnameFormat = function (value: string): boolean | string {$/

ctags.name: validSelection
ctags.pattern: /^export const validSelection = function (value: string | object | null) {$/

ctags.name: validTimeFormat
ctags.pattern: /^export const validTimeFormat = function (value: string): boolean | string {$/

ctags.name: validVideoURL
ctags.pattern: /^export const validVideoURL = function (value: string): boolean | string {$/
